description: This file provides utility functions for resolving and spawning a pnpm (a package manager) runner process, including platform-specific command construction and argument escaping.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments for running pnpm, considering platform-specific path and environment settings.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates a spawn specification object with command, arguments, and options for spawning the pnpm process.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a new process to run pnpm using the spawn specification.
